description: This source file defines the internal sealed partial class 'ClusterConnectionStatusObserverAdaptor' which implements the 'IClusterConnectionStatusObserver' interface. The class manages cluster connection events, specifically notifying handlers about cluster connection loss and gateway count changes. It uses immutable collections to store handlers, logs errors through defined methods, and interacts with event handler delegates related to cluster connectivity.

classes.name: ClusterConnectionStatusObserverAdaptor
classes.description: Implements cluster connection status observation, managing event handlers for connection loss and gateway count changes.

methods.name: NotifyClusterConnectionLost
methods.description: Notifies all connection lost handlers of a cluster connection loss.

methods.name: NotifyGatewayCountChanged
methods.description: Notifies all gateway count change handlers about a change in gateway count.
